# 2.154.0
First packaged release.
- **Install from a signed package.** A notarized `.pkg` installer sets up Stenographer without needing a source checkout. An optional component installs the `claude-account` shell integration (off by default). - **Automatic updates.** Stenographer now checks for updates in the background and offers them from a new **Check for Updates…** menu item. - **Smoother updates.** After installing an update, Stenographer finishes its own setup automatically — no manual steps required. - **The command-line tool is now `snog`.** It replaces `stenographer`; setup moves your status line over to it automatically.
